title: 第12章 阎罗之祝和亚圣的瞩目
novel_title: 巫师：让你学知识，你杀穿万界？
content_zh:
推开一扇扇矮门，钻进去查看。

    有的墓穴空间逼仄，石床硬邦邦的，连灯都没有。

    有的好一些，但也好得有限。

    直到伊森推开第十七扇门。

    里面空间至少有七八平米，石床宽大得足以并排躺下三个人。

    垫子是某种魔兽皮毛缝制的，触感柔软温暖。

    墙上嵌着四面水晶镜面，分别显示着甲板四个方向的景象。

    更妙的是，角落里还有一个狭小的隔间，里面竟然是完整的洗漱间。

    “就这间了。”

    伊森正要钻进自己的墓穴，身后传来异动。

    他猛地转身。

    甲板上，那些横七竖八的尸体，正在发生变化。

    鲜血最先动起来。

    那些在甲板上肆意流淌、汇聚成溪流的血液，仿佛突然有了生命。

    它们逆着重力，朝四面八方蔓延开来，如同无数条细小的红色蛇，钻进甲板表面的每一道缝隙。

    伊森瞳孔微缩。

    他低下头，看向脚下的甲板。

    那些血液钻进缝隙的瞬间，惨白的骨骼表面浮现出一道道细密的红色纹路。纹路如同活物，顺着骨骼的纹理蔓延、交织、融合，最后消失不见。

    紧接着，尸体开始缓缓下沉。

    那些横七竖八的尸体，仿佛躺在流沙上，身体一点一点地陷进甲板。先是背部，然后是腰，再是胸，最后是头。

    整个过程无声无息。

    只是那样安静地、缓慢地、一点一点地沉入惨白的骨骼甲板之中。

    伊森站在原地，目光扫过整个甲板。

    一百多具尸体。

    横七竖八。

    血流成河。

    现在，那些尸体正在以肉眼可见的速度消失。一具接一具，沉入甲板，如同沉入水面，连半点涟漪都没有泛起。

    约莫十几息后，最后一具尸体也没入了甲板。

    最后一缕鲜血也钻进了缝隙。

    甲板恢复了原状。

    依旧是那片惨白的、由无数根骨骼拼接而成的甲板。光滑，平整，干净得没有半点血迹，没有半点污渍，仿佛刚才那场屠杀从未发生过。

    只有空气中残留的淡淡血腥味，提醒着伊森，刚才的一切都是真实的。

    伊森站在原地，沉默了几息。

    他低头，看向脚下的甲板。

    惨白的骨骼表面，隐约可见细密的纹路。那些纹路如同活物，缓慢地流淌着，隐约能看出血液的颜色。

    “这是在......进食？”伊森挑起眉梢，低声自语。

    这艘飞艇，是活的？
content_en:
Push open the low doors and get in to check.

    Some tombs are cramped, with hard stone beds and no lights.

    Some are better, but not so good.

    Until Ethan pushed open the seventeenth door.

    The space inside is at least seven or eight square meters, and the stone bed is wide enough for three people to lie side by side.

    The cushions were sewn from the fur of some kind of monster, soft and warm to the touch.

    There are four crystal mirrors embedded in the wall, showing the scenes from the four directions of the deck.

    What's even better is that there is a small cubicle in the corner, which turns out to be a complete washroom.

    "This is it."

    Ethan was about to get into his tomb when something strange happened behind him.

    He turned sharply.

    On the deck, the corpses scattered everywhere are changing.

    Blood was the first to move.

    The blood flowing freely on the deck and gathering into streams seemed to suddenly come to life.

    They defy gravity and spread in all directions, like countless tiny red snakes, burrowing into every crack on the deck surface.

    Ethan's pupils narrowed.

    He lowered his head and looked at the deck beneath his feet.

    The moment the blood seeped into the gaps, fine red lines appeared on the surface of the pale bones. The lines are like living things, spreading, intertwining, and merging along the texture of the bones, and finally disappear.

    Immediately afterwards, the body began to sink slowly.

    Those scattered corpses seemed to be lying on quicksand, their bodies sinking into the deck bit by bit. First the back, then the waist, then the chest, and finally the head.

    The whole process was silent.

    It just sank into the pale skeletal deck so quietly, slowly, and little by little.

    Ethan stood there, his eyes scanning the entire deck.

    More than a hundred corpses.

    Seven horizontally and eight vertically.

    Rivers of blood flowed.

    Now, those corpses are disappearing at a speed visible to the naked eye. One by one, they sank onto the deck, as if they were sinking into the water, without even the slightest ripple.

    About ten breaths later, the last body also entered the deck.

    The last ray of blood also got into the gap.

    The deck was restored to its original condition.

    It was still the pale deck made of countless bones. Smooth, flat, and clean without any trace of blood or stain, as if the massacre just now had never happened.

    Only the faint smell of blood lingering in the air reminded Ethan that everything just now was real.

    Ethan stood there and was silent for a few breaths.

    He lowered his head and looked at the deck beneath his feet.

    Fine lines are faintly visible on the pale bone surface. Those lines were like living things, flowing slowly, and the color of blood could be vaguely seen.

    "Are you... eating?" Ethan raised his eyebrows and whispered to himself.

    Is this airship alive?
